title: 雪梨港灣大橋
subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
summary: 雪梨港灣大橋是跨度 503 公尺的雙鉸鋼拱橋，拱頂高出水面 134 公尺，橋面同時承載公路、鐵路、自行車道與人行道，1932 年通車。本課從雙鉸拱的推力與荷載路徑出發，分析桁架深度變化、鉚接與支承銷，再拆解兩岸以 128 條隧道錨碇鋼索支撐半拱懸臂架設、1930 年拱頂合龍與 1932 年 96 輛機車的載重試驗，最後談鉚接細節的疲勞評估、大面積塗裝維護，以及作為工程遺產的修繕與交接。
summaryEn: Sydney Harbour Bridge is a two-hinged steel arch spanning 503 m, its crown 134 m above the water, carrying road, rail, cycleway and footway since 1932. Starting from the thrust and load path of a two-hinged arch, the course examines varying truss depth, riveting and bearing pins, then the cantilever erection of each half-arch held back by 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels, the 1930 crown closure and the 1932 load test with 96 locomotives, ending with fatigue assessment of riveted details, painting of a vast steel surface and repair and handover of an engineering heritage structure.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」與「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" and "Truss depth and unbalanced loading": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙鉸拱支承」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-hinged arch bearings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。橋面以吊桿懸掛在拱下，同時承載公路、兩條鐵路、自行車道與人行道；四座以花崗岩飾面的橋塔位於拱端，主要是建築與視覺作用，並不承擔拱的推力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙鉸拱支承」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bridge consists of two parallel arch trusses, each supported only by hinges at its two ends on the abutments, making it a two-hinged arch: the supports can rotate but not move horizontally, so the weight of the arch and deck travels mainly as axial compression along the ribs to the supports, producing a large horizontal thrust resisted by sandstone and concrete abutments on each shore. The deck hangs from the arch on vertical hangers and carries road lanes, two railway tracks, a cycleway and a footway; the four granite-faced pylons at the arch ends are mainly architectural and visual and do not resist the arch thrust. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two-hinged arch bearings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙鉸拱支承」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two-hinged arch bearings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch
knowledge.text: 雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。橋面以吊桿懸掛在拱下，同時承載公路、兩條鐵路、自行車道與人行道；四座以花崗岩飾面的橋塔位於拱端，主要是建築與視覺作用，並不承擔拱的推力。
knowledge.textEn: The bridge consists of two parallel arch trusses, each supported only by hinges at its two ends on the abutments, making it a two-hinged arch: the supports can rotate but not move horizontally, so the weight of the arch and deck travels mainly as axial compression along the ribs to the supports, producing a large horizontal thrust resisted by sandstone and concrete abutments on each shore. The deck hangs from the arch on vertical hangers and carries road lanes, two railway tracks, a cycleway and a footway; the four granite-faced pylons at the arch ends are mainly architectural and visual and do not resist the arch thrust.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「雪梨港灣大橋」的「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「跨河橋梁試載日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: mechanism and load path” in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Bridge proof-test day” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" is correct?
options: 雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。
雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。
拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。
optionsEn: The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust.

The bridge consists of two parallel arch trusses, each supported only by hinges at its two ends on the abutments, making it a two-hinged arch: the supports can rotate but not move horizontally, so the weight of the arch and deck travels mainly as axial compression along the ribs to the supports, producing a large horizontal thrust resisted by sandstone and concrete abutments on each shore.
An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bridge consists of two parallel arch trusses, each supported only by hinges at its two ends on the abutments, making it a two-hinged arch: the supports can rotate but not move horizontally, so the weight of the arch and deck travels mainly as axial compression along the ribs to the supports, producing a large horizontal thrust resisted by sandstone and concrete abutments on each shore. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙鉸拱支承」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-hinged arch bearings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。取 w = 700 kN/m（恆載加活載）、L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m：H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN；每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN。每側兩個支承各分擔一半，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。w 與 f 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f). With w = 700 kN/m (dead plus live), L = 503 m and rise f = 120 m, H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN, and the vertical reaction per side is V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN. Each side has two bearings sharing half, so one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. w and f are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。取 w = 700 kN/m（恆載加活載）、L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m：H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN；每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN。每側兩個支承各分擔一半，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。w 與 f 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f). With w = 700 kN/m (dead plus live), L = 503 m and rise f = 120 m, H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN, and the vertical reaction per side is V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN. Each side has two bearings sharing half, so one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. w and f are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch", which statement holds?
options: 鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。
兩個半拱只要對準就能直接接上，溫度影響可以忽略。
拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。
optionsEn: Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance.
The two half-arches can simply be joined once aligned, and temperature can be ignored.
For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f).
quiz.explanation: 拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙鉸拱支承」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-hinged arch bearings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：評估或改建前應先依原設計與竣工資料畫出明確的荷載路徑圖，標示受力構件與非結構構件；任何鄰近橋台的開挖或隧道工程都要先檢核對橋台水平位移的影響並設監測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before assessment or alteration, draw an explicit load-path diagram from original design and as-built records that separates structural from non-structural elements; any excavation or tunnelling near the abutments must first be checked for its effect on horizontal movement and monitored.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 評估或改建前應先依原設計與竣工資料畫出明確的荷載路徑圖，標示受力構件與非結構構件；任何鄰近橋台的開挖或隧道工程都要先檢核對橋台水平位移的影響並設監測。
knowledge.textEn: Before assessment or alteration, draw an explicit load-path diagram from original design and as-built records that separates structural from non-structural elements; any excavation or tunnelling near the abutments must first be checked for its effect on horizontal movement and monitored.

quiz.question: 要驗證「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch"?
options: 以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
百年老橋沒有倒，代表它不會有疲勞問題。
optionsEn: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A century-old bridge that is still standing cannot have fatigue problems.
quiz.explanation: 以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙鉸拱支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-hinged arch bearings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：橋面以吊桿懸掛在拱下，同時承載公路、兩條鐵路、自行車道與人行道；四座以花崗岩飾面的橋塔位於拱端，主要是建築與視覺作用，並不承擔拱的推力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The deck hangs from the arch on vertical hangers and carries road lanes, two railway tracks, a cycleway and a footway; the four granite-faced pylons at the arch ends are mainly architectural and visual and do not resist the arch thrust.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。
knowledge.textEn: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。
拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply.
An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拱肋桁架深度」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch truss depth” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。如果荷載完全均勻並與拱軸吻合，拱只受軸壓；但列車、車流只佔半跨時，拱會產生彎矩，由上下弦桿的拉壓差承擔。桁架越深，同樣彎矩造成的弦桿力越小，所以在彎矩較大的區域加深桁架是有效率的做法。溫度變化也會讓雙鉸拱產生內力與變形：公開資料指出，炎熱天氣時拱頂可升高約 18 公分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拱肋桁架深度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons. If loading were perfectly uniform and matched the arch axis, the arch would be in pure compression; but trains and traffic on half the span cause bending, carried as a push–pull difference between top and bottom chords. The deeper the truss, the smaller the chord forces for the same moment, so deepening the truss where moments are larger is efficient. Temperature also causes forces and movement in a two-hinged arch: public sources note that the crown can rise by about 18 cm on hot days. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Arch truss depth” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拱肋桁架深度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Arch truss depth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載
knowledge.text: 拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。如果荷載完全均勻並與拱軸吻合，拱只受軸壓；但列車、車流只佔半跨時，拱會產生彎矩，由上下弦桿的拉壓差承擔。
knowledge.textEn: The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons. If loading were perfectly uniform and matched the arch axis, the arch would be in pure compression; but trains and traffic on half the span cause bending, carried as a push–pull difference between top and bottom chords.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Truss depth and unbalanced loading" is correct?
options: 拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。
鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。
拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。
optionsEn: An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered.
Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies.
The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons.
quiz.explanation: 拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱肋桁架深度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch truss depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。若半跨活載在某斷面產生 M = 400,000 kN·m：在桁架深 h = 30 m 處 ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN；若同樣彎矩出現在拱頂 h = 18 m 處，ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN，增加約 67%。彎矩值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h. If half-span live load produces M = 400,000 kN·m at a section where h = 30 m, ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN; the same moment at the crown with h = 18 m gives ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN, about 67% more. The moment is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。若半跨活載在某斷面產生 M = 400,000 kN·m：在桁架深 h = 30 m 處 ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN；若同樣彎矩出現在拱頂 h = 18 m 處，ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN，增加約 67%。彎矩值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h. If half-span live load produces M = 400,000 kN·m at a section where h = 30 m, ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN; the same moment at the crown with h = 18 m gives ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN, about 67% more. The moment is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Truss depth and unbalanced loading", which statement holds?
options: 弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。
鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。
載重試驗的目的是把橋加載到接近破壞，以證明它夠強。
optionsEn: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h.
A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.
A load test aims to load the bridge close to failure to prove it is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱肋桁架深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch truss depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拱橋評估必須包含半跨與偏心荷載排列及溫度組合，並列出每類桿件的最不利工況；量測資料應附溫度紀錄，避免把溫度內力誤判為荷載效應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Arch assessment must include half-span and eccentric load patterns with temperature combinations and list the governing case for each member type; measurement data should carry temperature records so thermal forces are not mistaken for load effects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。
knowledge.textEn: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 拱橋評估必須包含半跨與偏心荷載排列及溫度組合，並列出每類桿件的最不利工況；量測資料應附溫度紀錄，避免把溫度內力誤判為荷載效應。
knowledge.textEn: Arch assessment must include half-span and eccentric load patterns with temperature combinations and list the governing case for each member type; measurement data should carry temperature records so thermal forces are not mistaken for load effects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Truss depth and unbalanced loading"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。
鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations.
As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur.
quiz.explanation: 以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱肋桁架深度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch truss depth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：溫度變化也會讓雙鉸拱產生內力與變形：公開資料指出，炎熱天氣時拱頂可升高約 18 公分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature also causes forces and movement in a two-hinged arch: public sources note that the crown can rise by about 18 cm on hot days.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Truss depth and unbalanced loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies.

quiz.explanation: 若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
